fusions.name: Out of the Brush
fusions.desc: Bursts out around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2 tiles back. Then your movement speed rises by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sly Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a stone at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 2 seconds. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Shifted Blame
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Made a Fool Of
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
